title: Tu Sac
notice: 112 four-colour cards. With no numeric order, only three combinations exist
label.drawPrompt: Draw from the stock or take the discard
label.discardPrompt: Lay a combination or discard one card
tutorial.deck: 112 cards: four colours by seven piece types, four copies each. There is no numeric order, so the usual rummy run does not exist
tutorial.meld: Only three combinations: three of one colour, a cross-colour chariot-horse-cannon, and five soldiers. What you lay cannot be taken back
tutorial.score: You score melds minus the cards still in your hand, so holding on costs points
frontendHint.tusacDiscardToEndTurn: discard one card to pass the turn
frontendHint.tusacHoldingCostsPoints: every card left in hand is a point against you
